overview_intro: The state of the platform and the requests waiting for you.
pending_empty: No request is waiting for review.
claims_intro: Check who is asking, then approve or reject. The person is told by email.
claims_search: Search by mosque, name or email
claims_empty_pending: No request is waiting for review.
no_results_hint: Try another name, a city, or remove a filter.
decision_intro: Approving makes this person the owner of the mosque's page. Both decisions send an email.
approve_text: They will be able to publish on the page and update its details. You can withdraw this right at any time.
approve_note_placeholder: A word of welcome or a practical tip…
reject_text: The person will receive your explanation by email and can send a new request.
reject_note_placeholder: Explain kindly what is missing or why…
reject_note_hint: Required — it is sent to the person.
claim_approved: {name} now manages this mosque. They have been told by email.
claim_rejected: The request from {name} was rejected. They have been told by email.
claim_already_decided: This request has already been decided.
mosques_intro: Correct a record, verify a mosque, see who manages it.
details_intro: Fix the name, address or position shown on the map.
field_timezone_hint: Used to show the mosque's local time.
verification_text: Mark the mosque as verified once its documents and finances have been checked. Only verified mosques will be able to collect donations when this becomes available.
verify_text: Confirm that the mosque's documents and finances have been checked. A badge will appear on its page.
unverify_text: The badge disappears and the mosque would no longer be eligible for fundraising.
mosque_unverified: {name} is no longer marked as verified.
revoke_manager_text: They will no longer be able to publish for {mosque}.
users_intro: Accounts on the platform and who can administer it.
grant_admin_text: Admins review requests, verify mosques and manage every account. Only give this right to people you trust.
revoke_admin_text: They keep their account and their mosques, but lose access to the administration.
error_self_admin: You cannot remove your own admin rights.
error_last_admin: The platform needs at least one admin.
error_unverified_admin: This account has not verified its email address yet.
v_timezone: Choose a time zone from the list.
v_note_max: The note must be 1,000 characters or fewer.
